reader.requirement: At --std 85 the program-name of PROGRAM-ID must be a user-defined word: at most 30 characters drawn from A-Z (lowercase equivalent), 0-9 and hyphen, hyphen neither first nor last, at least one letter, not a 1985 reserved word (LENGTH/RANDOM/SUM included), and never a literal or a word with an underscore or other character.

edition-consulted.switches: below 2002 asks ViolationAtEveryEdition instead of the edition's Annex B table; separator-position check is shared
ConstructRegistry gates UserWordUnderscore2002 and UserWordExtendedLetter2002 (COBOL0900 at 85, no-op from 2002)
IsReservedAt(edition.Year): the 1985 reserved list (ALTER, LABEL, PROCEED, LENGTH reserved at 85 refused with COBOL0901)
reads _edition.Year for the length ceiling via CobolWordRule.MaxLength

reader.edition-search: Grepped the diagnostics the probes drew (COBOL2773, COBOL1567, COBOL0901, COBOL2693, COBOL0900) to their sites; CheckLetter consults no edition (same rule every edition).
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: the length ceiling is 30 at 1985 (63 at 2023), the underscore and extended letters are refused at 1985, the reserved-word set is the 1985 list, and the AS externalized-name and IS PROTOTYPE phrases are refused at 1985
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness exercises only a trailing hyphen; length, leading hyphen, letterless, underscore, reserved word, literal and special characters are not exercised

reader.notes: Every part of the user-defined-word formation rule is enforced at 85 and the length, character-set and reserved-word arms take the 1985 values. Diagnostics cite §2023 clause numbers in their text even at --std 85 (a wording matter, not a conformance failure). The all-digit name draws a parser 'no literal expected' rather than COBOL2693 because the lexer reads 12345 as a literal; it is still refused.

refuter.evidence: Compared the 1985 reserved-word list (§1985:IV.8, 351 words incl. FUNCTION per Amendment 2) mechanically against ReservedWords.Table.cs R85 rows (refute-1985-156/rw.py): every 1985 word is R85 at high confidence and no R85 row is outside the 1985 list. Probes at --std 85 (runs under refute-1985-156/runs): lowercase with doubled hyphens 'abc--1x' RAN; 30-char mixed-case name RAN, 31-char refused COBOL1567; nested program-name of 31 chars refused COBOL1567 at its PROGRAM-ID; nested 'IN1-' refused COBOL2773; nested 'ALTER' refused COBOL0901; nested IN-1 IS COMMON called and ran; RANDOM and SUM refused (COBOL5506, IV.4.2.2.1 2b); ENTER and DEBUG-ITEM (1985-only reserved) refused COBOL0901; END-ACCEPT, TYPEDEF (2002 reserved), ARITHMETIC (later context word) and MAX (function-name, intersecting set per IV.4.2.2.1 1b) accepted and RAN. Cite: OK §1985:VI.3.3.3 SR1; OK §1985:IV.4.2.2.1 (SR2b) 'may not be used as a system-name or as a user-defined word regardless of context'; OK §1985:IV.4.2.2.1.1 'all user-defined words must contain at least one alphabetic character'. Side observation (wording only): the COBOL5506 for RANDOM lists reserved words such as ALTER and the 2002 word METHOD as 'expected' after PROGRAM-ID.
